abstract: The study explores the efficacy and safety of cryoablation combined with the dual-function antibody PD-1/CTLA-4 (Apalulizumab) for the treatment of locally advanced pancreatic cancer following failure of first-line AG therapy. This research aims to accumulate more clinical evidence and treatment options for second-line therapy in locally advanced pancreatic cancer following failure of first-line regimen.
title: Cryoablation Combined With the Dual-Function Antibody PD-1/CTLA-4 for the Treatment of LAPC Following Failure of First-Line AG Therapy
